attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yegH`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 13% of calls, and the model names 99% of them. It is the only spine column before the long variable stretch.

**Columns 1 to 21 are variable, all shell, carried by 54 to 83%**, the `wca` genes, [[colanic acid biosynthesis]]. Through columns 60 to 62 a branch of 3 shell families runs in 15%, and through columns 72 to 76 a branch of 5 shell families runs in 14 to 15%, [[propanediol dehydratase]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 88% against 75%, and hesitates less there, 0.44 against 0.90 bits. Its most hesitant column, 23, `rfbB`, is a variable column, at 2.13 bits.

**The window ends in fork columns.** Columns 52 to 79 are carried by 7 to 84% of chromosomes, and the model names 73 to 88% of them. The last column is `yeeN`, in 34% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 78% of genes**, 0.81 bits on average, perplexity 2.9 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.09 against 0.40 bits, and names fewer genes, 68% against 91%.

label: yegH
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yegH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yegH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,656 to 1,735 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yegH once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 78% of genes, 0.81 bits on average (perplexity 2.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 15,416 calls, named 95%, 0.35 bits; shell 23,571 calls, named 77%, 0.84 bits; cloud 3,973 calls, named 14%, 2.41 bits. Outside an RGP 17,322 calls, named 91%, 0.40 bits; inside an RGP 25,638 calls, named 68%, 1.09 bits. Columns: 15 spine, 23 fork, 42 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.09 against 0.40 bits) and names fewer genes (68% against 91%); 25,638 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 23 (rfbB, a variable column) 2.13 bits, RGP 92%; column 24 (rfbD, a variable column) 1.87 bits, RGP 93%; column 27 (gatA, a variable column) 1.62 bits, RGP 89%. The 54 columns (columns 1-32 and 58-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 73%, 0.92 bits on average; the other 26 columns: named 86%, 0.59 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 15 spine columns: named 88%, 0.44 bits on average; the 65 fork and variable columns: named 75%, 0.90 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 23, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-33 (fork and variable columns), RGP 44-93%; the least: columns 37-46 (spine), RGP 9-11%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
